_note: SYNTHETIC PATIENT. Fictional person created for demonstration. Any resemblance to a real person is coincidental. Loosely FHIR R4-shaped for readability; not a validated FHIR bundle.

patient.name: Thomas Varghese
patient.lifestyle: Never smoker. Alcohol: occasional (1-2 units/week). Diet: rice-based Kerala meals, 3 cups tea with sugar daily. Walks less than before because of knee pain.
patient.familyHistory: Father: type 2 diabetes, MI at 66. Mother: hypertension. No known family history of cancer.

medications.name: Aceclofenac
medications.frequency: twice daily as needed for knee pain (self-reported use most days)

cgm.events: Hypoglycaemia (<70 mg/dL) on 9 of 14 nights, clustered 02:00-04:30; lowest 48 mg/dL. Post-lunch peaks (rice meal ~13:00) and post-dinner peaks (~20:30) most days.

timeline.title: Annual review
timeline.detail: HbA1c 7.8%, Hb 13.4 g/dL. Glargine 16 U added to metformin + glimepiride.

timeline.title: WhatsApp symptom intake and triage
timeline.detail: Returning patient messaged about high sugars, night sweats, knee pain and weight loss. Triaged to Endocrinology within 1 week; red flags passed to the clinician.

timeline.title: Endocrinology OPD: poor glycaemic control, knee pain, weight loss
timeline.detail: Consult documented by ambient scribe. CGM applied. Labs sent.

timeline.title: 14-day CGM review
timeline.detail: Time in range 41%, nocturnal hypoglycaemia on 9 of 14 nights. Regimen revised.

timeline.title: Ortho OPD: right total knee replacement planning
timeline.detail: Pre-op optimisation flagged unexplained iron-deficiency anaemia; GI referral made before elective surgery.

timeline.title: Colonoscopy: sigmoid mass, biopsied
timeline.detail: Ulcerated circumferential mass at 25 cm. Biopsy: adenocarcinoma, moderately differentiated. CEA 6.8.

timeline.title: Multidisciplinary tumour board
timeline.detail: cT3 N1 M0 sigmoid adenocarcinoma (stage III). Plan: laparoscopic resection, then adjuvant chemotherapy. Knee replacement deferred.

timeline.title: Pre-operative cardiac assessment
timeline.detail: RCRI 2, exertional chest heaviness, 1 mm ST depression V5–V6. Expedited stress imaging recommended without delaying cancer surgery.

timeline.title: Dobutamine stress echo: no inducible ischaemia
timeline.detail: Target heart rate reached, no wall-motion abnormality. Symptoms attributed to anaemia and deconditioning. Cleared for surgery with a peri-operative cardiac plan.

timeline.title: Cashless pre-authorisation for laparoscopic resection
timeline.detail: Coverage checked against policy clauses, estimate and medical-necessity letter prepared, room-rent deduction explained to the family.

timeline.title: Laparoscopic anterior resection
timeline.detail: R0 resection. Pathology pT3 pN1b (2/18 nodes) M0, stage IIIB.

timeline.title: Discharge, post-operative day 5
timeline.detail: Discharge summary, patient instructions and follow-up plan generated.

documents.colonoscopy: 2026-07-29 Colonoscopy (Gastroenterology): Adequate prep (BBPS 7). Ulcerated, friable, near-circumferential mass at 25 cm from anal verge (sigmoid), scope passed with difficulty. Remaining colon to caecum: two diminutive polyps removed (transverse). Biopsies from mass. Tattoo placed distal to lesion.
documents.pathologyBiopsy: 2026-07-31 Histopathology: Sigmoid mass biopsy - invasive adenocarcinoma, moderately differentiated. Immunohistochemistry: MLH1, PMS2, MSH2, MSH6 retained (mismatch-repair proficient, pMMR). Molecular panel: KRAS G12D mutant; NRAS wild-type; BRAF V600E not detected. Transverse polyps: tubular adenomas, low-grade dysplasia.
documents.ctStaging: 2026-08-01 CECT thorax, abdomen, pelvis: 4.5 cm segment of irregular circumferential wall thickening in sigmoid colon with pericolic fat stranding, no definite breach of serosa into adjacent organs (radiological T3). Three pericolic lymph nodes, largest 11 mm short axis (N1). Liver: no focal lesion. Lungs: no nodules. No ascites.
documents.kneeXray: 2026-07-22 X-ray right knee, standing AP + lateral + skyline, and long-leg alignment view: Severe medial tibiofemoral joint space loss with bone-on-bone contact, subchondral sclerosis, marginal osteophytes, subchondral cysts in medial tibial plateau (Kellgren-Lawrence grade 4). Moderate patellofemoral OA. Mechanical axis: 12 degrees varus. No fracture or loosening. Left knee: KL grade 2.
documents.operativeNote: 2026-08-19 Laparoscopic anterior resection with high ligation of inferior mesenteric artery, stapled colorectal anastomosis, leak test negative. No diverting stoma. EBL 150 mL. Duration 210 min.
documents.pathologyResection: 2026-08-22 Resection histopathology: Adenocarcinoma, moderately differentiated, 4.2 cm, invades through muscularis propria into pericolorectal tissue (pT3). No lymphovascular or perineural invasion. 2 of 18 lymph nodes positive (pN1b). Proximal, distal and radial margins clear (R0). No tumour deposits. pMMR (confirmed).
